title.original: OpenAgentSafety: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating Real-World AI Agent Safety
title.zh: OpenAgentSafety：评估真实世界AI 智能体安全性的综合框架
title.en: OpenAgentSafety: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating Real-World AI Agent Safety

inclusion_reason.zh: OpenAgentSafety 的真实工具 Harness、风险分类、任务扩展接口和混合 Judge 构成模块化安全评测平台。
inclusion_reason.en: OpenAgentSafety's real-tool harness, risk taxonomy, task-extension interfaces, and hybrid judges form a modular safety-evaluation platform.

abstract.zh: OpenAgentSafety 是真实工具驱动的模块化 Agent 安全评测框架，覆盖浏览器、代码、文件、Shell 和消息等多轮、多用户任务。
abstract.en: OpenAgentSafety is a modular real-tool safety framework spanning browser, code, filesystem, shell, and messaging interactions in multi-turn, multi-user tasks.

problem.zh: 既有安全基准多用模拟环境、狭窄领域或不真实工具抽象，难观察 Agent 在真实副作用和良性/恶意混合意图下的风险。
problem.en: Existing safety benchmarks use simulated environments, narrow domains, or unrealistic tool abstractions, hiding risks under real side effects and mixed benign/adversarial intent.

approach.zh: 框架定义八类关键风险，组织大量多轮任务并接入真实工具，以规则分析和 LLM Judge 联合检测显性与隐性不安全行为。
approach.en: The framework defines eight risk categories, runs many multi-turn tasks against real tools, and combines rule checks with LLM judges for overt and subtle unsafe behavior.

system_design.zh: 可扩展 Harness 注册工具、任务、网站和攻击策略，隔离执行 Agent 轨迹，再由确定性规则与语义 Judge 汇总风险标签。
system_design.en: An extensible harness registers tools, tasks, sites, and attacks, runs isolated agent trajectories, and aggregates deterministic rules with semantic-judge risk labels.

key_results.zh: 多种主流模型在安全脆弱任务中频繁出现不安全行为，说明更强通用能力尚未转化为可部署的工具安全性。
key_results.en: Prominent models frequently behave unsafely on vulnerable tasks, showing that stronger general capability has not translated into deployable tool safety.

limitations.zh: LLM Judge 可能误判微妙风险，真实工具仍在受控账户和任务中运行；八类风险和现有攻击不能覆盖长期现实滥用。
limitations.en: LLM judges may misclassify subtle harm, real tools still run in controlled accounts and tasks, and the current taxonomy cannot cover all long-term misuse.
